message.title: SOLSTAD OFFSHORE ASA - Extraordinary General Meeting in Solstad Offshore ASA held
message.body:
The Extraordinary General Meeting in Solstad Offshore ASA was held today, 24
September 2026.

All proposals on the agenda were approved.

The minutes from the general meeting is attached and also available on Solstad's
website.

Skudeneshavn, 24 September 2026

Contacts

Lars Peder Solstad CEO, +47 91 31 85 85

Kjetil Ramstad CFO, +47 90 75 94 89

Solstad Offshore ASA

www.solstad.com

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements according to the
Norwegian Securities Trading Act section 5-12.
